query: select target.id as player_id, target.trainer_name, snapshot.display_name as "display_name?" from players target left join lateral ( select s.display_name from player_discord_snapshots s where s.player_id = target.id order by s.id desc limit 1 ) snapshot on true where target.id <> $1 and ( position(lower($2) in lower(coalesce(snapshot.display_name, ''))) > 0 or position(lower($2) in lower(coalesce(target.trainer_name, ''))) > 0 or target.discord_user_id::text = $2 ) order by target.trainer_name nulls last, snapshot.display_name nulls last, target.id limit 20
